notes: Placeholder API/translation keys, account-ID suffix on bucket names (names are matched by prefix, or by a declared local/variable whose name states the tier) and local-file upload contents are not checked beyond the declared s3 object. Bucket names built only inside a locals map with each.value are not observable. Versioning/public-access/SSE are counted, not bound to each named bucket (names are unknown at plan). Glue-role grants are not bound to the Glue role (the GT carries them in a policy document attached through aws_iam_role_policy, a chain the interpreter cannot follow); the Glue-access check uses Data Catalog actions so the Step Functions job-run grants do not satisfy it. Start/monitor grants are bound to a policy that references the Glue jobs. 'Only those two jobs' and 'limited to the six buckets' are checked as a reference to the jobs/buckets, not as the absence of a wildcard resource. An aws_glue_catalog_database named silver is accepted as the Athena database (Athena databases are Glue Data Catalog databases); its encryption is only checked on aws_athena_database. Job ordering (extract then transform) is not checked. Candidate review: transform_extra_modules fails on all 3 real templates, none of which set --additional-python-modules; GLM's '--datalake-format' (singular) is not a Glue argument, so transform_iceberg keeps failing it.
